targets.authors: Labandeira, X., Labeaga, J. M. and Teixidó, J.
targets.title: Major Reforms in Electricity Pricing: Evidence from a Quasi-Experiment
targets.evidence_quote:
This replication paper investigates whether their code could recreate their final

targets.outcome_computational_quote:
All the author replication codes run and reproduce the results reported in the paper,
except for minor discrepancies in the reported standard errors in Tables 4 and 5.
The differences in Tables 4 and 5 do not change statistical significance; only the
last digit is off, i.e., .001 for most estimates.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
In contrast, year-quarter-region fixed effects reduce the statistical significance and
size of the estimates (a -66% to -157% reduction in the effect).
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original reported estimates reproduced with only negligible rounding differences. Alternative seasonality fixed effects substantially weaken the central OLS findings; IV findings also lose significance under corrections and alternatives.
